name: Audio: speaker, earpiece, headphones, microphone
description: tinyalsa-based audio HAL (OpenHarmony VDI) for the atoll sound card (WCD937x codec, TAS2562 speaker amplifier with its SmartPA feedback), using the curtana mixer paths (mixer_paths_wcd937x.xml). The audio policy is trimmed to what the hardware can do (no MMAP/offload/hotword pipes). Use it together with 'ADSP sensors domain', otherwise the DSP may restart every ~40 s. NEEDS A REBUILD of libaudio_primary_impl.z.so (build/build_ohos.sh): the prebuilt one in files/ is still sweet's until then.
